mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured by the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 2% in the past month indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% y/y), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% y/y and FEDFUNDS rises, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO declines by more than 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below -0.5% signals recession onset, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 growth is below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points each signals severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS declines by more than 100k and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25pp.
